question: What happens to the user-selected V6.1 Step 02 FF5/momentum portfolio when mandatory short exposure is removed and every other selector, formation, calibration, cost, objective, risk, capacity, and timing rule is preserved?

optimizer.minimum_short_gross.reason: Remove the explicit mandatory short sleeve.

optimizer.maximum_net.reason: With minimum long gross 0.50, retaining maximum net 0.30 would create an implicit minimum short gross of 0.20. This mechanical relaxation is required for zero shorts to be feasible.

unchanged: all frozen selector scores and targets
top-20-percent long and short candidate formation
market-beta, factor, SIC2, financing, trading-cost and borrow controls
no validation, tuning, retuning, or selector retraining
interpretation: Shorts remain permitted. They are chosen only when the unchanged expected-net objective and unchanged portfolio risk controls make them useful; there is no direct or net-exposure-induced short allocation floor.
